title: Rubio Warned Officials About Nvidia Chief’s Entanglement With Chinese Spy
summary: The secretary of state’s role in drafting a secret memo highlights how top officials were concerned this past spring about Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman tied to Chinese intelligence.
